description: This file defines a Next.js page component for displaying static information about defect details, including functions for static generation parameters and a React component for rendering the static notice page.

methods.name: generateStaticParams
methods.description: Asynchronously returns an empty array of defect IDs for static generation, indicating defect detail pages are not pre-rendered for dynamic IDs.

methods.name: DefectDetailStaticExportNotice
methods.description: React functional component rendering a static page informing users that defect details are not dynamically generated in this deployment.
